answer: Yes, an open safety recall doesn't stop us from buying your car, and it doesn't change your offer; you can get the free recall repair at a dealer for your car's brand first, but you don't have to. Any hail damage you know about should be listed on the damage disclosure form, NW-DMG-1, before the inspection: listed damage is already priced into your offer, while undisclosed damage can lower it at the appraisal. The help center doesn't cover whether an open insurance claim affects the sale, so please contact a store about that part.
